concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-merchant-account-create-node]] - Node.js merchant-account creation examples covering individual/business identity, bank-oriented funding, terms acceptance, master-merchant association and callback/Promise result shapes, without establishing universal onboarding eligibility
warnings: Treat displayed inputs as worked-example categories and values, not a universal required-field or merchant-eligibility contract.
Do not infer approval, activation, funding readiness, transaction eligibility, result fields, or success handling from the empty callback and Promise handlers.
Keep the response object, Marketplace overview, result-handling and service-fee links as navigation only unless their corresponding evidence is fully read for a retained claim.
